Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53977 of 2023

Applicant :- Sonu Katheria @ Raj Thakur
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjeev Kumar Khare
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State, apprised the Court that notice has been served to the informant of the case on 8.12.2023.
2.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.
3. Sri Sandeep Kumar Dubey, learned Advocate, has filed his power today on behalf of the High Court Legal Services Committee, which is taken on record.

4. Heard Sri Sanjeev Kumar Khare, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sandeep Kumar Dubey,
learned counsel for the High Court Legal Servicces and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State.

5. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.130 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504 and 507 IPC and Sonu Katheria @ Raj Thakur vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others

6. FIR of the present case was lodged against unknown persons and according to the FIR, daughter of the informant aged about 15 years had gone somewhere from her house and she has also taken silver jewellery with her.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that nobody was named in the FIR but during investigation when the statement of the victim was recorded then applicant was made accused in the present matter.

8. He further submits that even from the perusal of both the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., no offence against the applicant is made out and victim categorically stated that she herself had gone along with applicant and also performed marriage with him.
9.
He further submits that victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,categorically stated that no physical relationship was ever developed between her and applicant.
10. He further submits that even as per school record at the time of incident victim was more than 17 years old and during investigation her ossification test was not conducted.
11. He further submits that it is a case of love affair and applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 22.8.2023.

12. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel appearing for the High Court Legal Services Committee although opposed the prayerfor bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant.
13. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

14. From the record it reflects that applicant was not named in the FIR and during investigation through the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.applicant was made accused but even from the statements of the victim recorded during investigation it appears that victim did not make any allegation against the applicant and stated that she herself had gone along with the applicant and also performed marriage with him.
15.
Further, even from the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. it also reflects that no physical relationship were developed between both of them.
16. Further, even as per school record at the time of incident victim was more than 17 years of age and during investigation her ossification test was not conducted.
17. Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 22.8.2023.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
19. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

20. Let the applicant-Sonu Katheria @ Raj Thakur be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
21. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

22. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 SKM  Sonu Katheria @ Raj Thakur vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166725423/
